newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: LA RETAIL TO DOUBLE SIZE OF BUSINESS IN S.AFRICA.
newsitem.headline: LA RETAIL TO DOUBLE SIZE OF BUSINESS IN S.AFRICA.

text.p: Soon-to-be-listed LA Retail Stores said on Tuesday that it planned to more than double the size of its business in South Africa in three years.

Chief executive Abdul Peer said in a statement the group planned to increase the number of stores to more than 55 from the current 18, introduce extended credit facilities to customers and investigate franchising opportunities by 1998.
LA Retail Stores is due to be listed on October 14 after signing an agreement to reverse list into the Ensign cash shell.
